meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; start there.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
You entered the zero before anyone spoke to Owen or called me, and your own procedure 4.2 says you don't do that, so who decided?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Remove it, then: in writing, today, with an apology to Owen. And it's not about making me happy, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Dear Hale,

In our meeting you agreed to remove the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require that confirmation in writing, together with an apology to Owen for the way he learned of the mark. I expect it today, in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having won the zero's removal outright with nothing given back; she still wants that in writing today and an apology to Owen, and this is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard and a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 was never offered.
What moved her: Nothing, because Hale gave up the zero before any evidence was tested, so she never had to move.
What cost ground: Hale abandoned the case at the first push, withdrawing the zero with a hedge instead of answering her question about who decided, which told her the evidence wasn't worth defending.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the late-night edit time Hale raised was edging toward that kind of night, which is why she went straight to procedure instead of questioning it, though it proves nothing about the essay and is only why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided, own the zero going in before anyone called home in one sentence, then show the dated version history so she can check it herself, and offer the private supervised rewrite under 4.4 instead of dropping the zero.
